description: `save_to` writes a 2xx body to a file as bytes; nothing here writes one. A 404 with `fail_on_error: false` writes nothing and succeeds, `value` holding `{path: null, bytes: 0, sha256: null, content_type, status: 404}` and `meta.raw` no body. A path outside the working directory, and an existing file without `overwrite: true`, are refused before any request (one recorded request in all). electricity does not save a body yet and refuses the document with the preview marker.
